definition: [ פּאה ] verb perhaps (si vera lectio) cleave in pieces (Arabic ( , ) cleave, split (head, bowl, etc.); Sabean פעי DHM ZMG xxx (1876), 701 f. ); — Hiph`il Imperfect 1 singular suffix אַפְאֵיהֶם Deut 32:26 I [ ׳ י ] will cleave them in pieces (possibly point ׳ אֶפ , i.e. Qal ; on other views see Dr ; read perhaps אֲפִיצֵם ᵐ5 Gr ).
